spans.s: द्रोण (I) m. 1. A lake 400 poles in length; 2. a cloud full of water, अनावृष्टिहते शस्ये द्रोणवृष्टिरिवागता Mrich.x.; 3. a raven, a carrion crow; 4. a scorpion; 5. a tree in general; 6. a tree which bears flowers; 7. name of the preceptor of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas. (See App. II.)
द्रोण (II) m.n. 1. A measure of capacity equal to four āḍhakas, M.vii.126; 2. another measure of capacity, (the same as आढक q.v.).
द्रोण (III) n. A wooden vessel, a bucket, a tub, a trough.
द्रोण-क्षीरा, -घा, -दुग्धा, -दुघा f. a cow yielding a droṇa of milk.

द्रोण-मुख n. the capital of 400 villages.

द्रोणि f. 1. A bucket, an oval vessel of wood used for pouring out water; 2. a trough for feeding cattle; 3. a water-reservoir; 4. a measure of capacity equal to 2 śūrpas (in medicine); 5. a valley between two mountains, a valley, बृहद्द्रोणीशैलकांतारप्रदेशमधिष्ठितो माधवस्यांतिकं प्रयामि M.M.ix.

द्रोणि f. 1. A bucket, an oval vessel of wood used for pouring out water; 2. a trough for feeding cattle; 3. a water-reservoir; 4. a measure of capacity equal to 2 śūrpas (in medicine); 5. a valley between two mountains, a valley, बृहद्द्रोणीशैलकांतारप्रदेशमधिष्ठितो माधवस्यांतिकं प्रयामि M.M.ix.
द्रोह m. 1. Injury, mischief, malice, M.ii.161, Bg.i.37; 2. perfidy, treachery; 3. wrong, offence; 4. rebellion.
द्रोह-अट m. 1. a religious impostor; 2. a hunter.
द्रोह-चिंतन n. wish, thought or attempt to injure.
